title: DORA Art.8 Asset / Dependency & Critical-Function Map
description: Schema for the machine-readable asset & critical-function map mandated by DORA Art.8 (identification of ICT-supported business functions, information assets and the ICT assets/dependencies supporting them). This is REAL architectural data derived from the existing service-inventory.md, asset-inventory.md, vendor-risk-register.md and the BC/DR plan -- it is not the record of an unconducted activity, so it may legitimately PASS. Completeness (every critical function maps to >=1 supporting asset; every asset has an owner + criticality; every high-criticality function carries RTO+RPO) is enforced BLOCKING by check_asset_map.py. Any genuinely-unknown owner/RTO must be left empty so it surfaces as a completeness FAIL rather than being invented.

maintaining_entity.description: The entity maintaining the asset map and its review cadence.

sources.description: Provenance: the real inventories this map is derived from.

critical_functions.description: ICT-supported business functions (DORA Art.8). Each maps to the assets, data stores and third parties that support it.

supporting_assets.description: Asset IDs (must reference assets[].id) that this function depends on.

data_stores.description: Data store / information-asset IDs this function reads or writes.

third_parties.description: External provider names this function depends on (DORA ICT third-party dependency).

rto.description: Recovery Time Objective for this function. REQUIRED (non-empty) for high-criticality functions; enforced by the validator, not the schema, so an unknown RTO surfaces as a completeness FAIL rather than a schema-shape error.

rpo.description: Recovery Point Objective for this function. REQUIRED (non-empty) for high-criticality functions.

assets.description: ICT and information assets supporting the critical functions (derived from asset-inventory.md TA-*/IA-* and service-inventory.md SVC-*).

id.description: Stable asset identifier (e.g. TA-002, IA-005, SVC-001).

owner.description: Accountable owner role. REQUIRED non-empty; an unknown owner must be left empty/null so it surfaces as a completeness FAIL rather than an invented value.
